newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two dead, one at large in Mexico prison break.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, one at large in Mexico prison break.

text.p: Two prisoners were killed and another was at large on Tuesday following the dramatic escape of six men from a Mexico City prison, authorities said.
The remaining prisoners have been recaptured, police said.
A police officer was also injured during a shootout with the escapees in a corn field just outside Mexico City's South Prison, the Mexico City Public Security Ministry said in a news release.
Six men escaped from the prison in Mexico's City's Xochimilco district around midday, boarding two taxis and another sedan, police said.
Police helicopters immediately found four of the men, giving rise to the shootout that left policeman Armando Peralta injured. But Peralta was able to shoot dead escaped prisoner, Juan Velazquez.

Police later found another dead prisoner, Ricardo Lopez Lucio, in one of the escape cars which had been abandoned, and helicopters were being used to search for the one prisoner still on the run, the news release said.

The fugitive was identified as Raul Martinez Azpeitia, but the news release did not say why he was jailed. Others involved in the escape had been convicted of an array of crimes such as homicide, theft and drug dealing.
